decision: Reject this candidate. Moving orchestration into the Router wallet DO removed one request per registration, but Yao latency exceeded both baseline arms. Keep the accepted Phase 6AE implementation.
method: Three fresh implicit, unfunded NEAR wallets per sequential baseline/candidate/restored-baseline arm. The baseline includes accepted streamed Signing Worker delivery. Matching corrected NEP-413 SDK, Gateway, Runtime, Console, Deriver A, Deriver B, Signing Worker, bindings and requested APAC placement stayed fixed. The candidate changed only Router. Builds and local verification completed before timed browser runs.

initialFailures.issue: The Miniflare namespace API rejected a Node Request instance. The E2E now passes its URL and initialization fields.
Recovery fault bindings belonged to a Worker while its wallet DO used another Worker environment. The fixture now runs its wallet object with the same fault bindings.

independentSignatureVerification.verifier: Node.js crypto Ed25519 with independent NEP-413 Borsh encoding

setupAttempt.cause: The invalid setup probe returned invalid_body before any Console invocation. Its empty trace was incorrectly treated as a rollout failure. The run stopped before measurements and before candidate deployment.
setupAttempt.correction: Wait for binding convergence and audit every actual benchmark invocation version.

limitations: Three samples per arm do not establish percentiles, statistical significance or a latency guarantee.
The arms ran sequentially. Provider scheduling and network variation can affect comparisons.
All captured invocation versions matched the expected cohort in every arm. No failed or mismatched sample was excluded.
Fresh wallets do not prove cold Workers. Worker cold starts were not controlled.
Nested spans overlap and must not be added. Protocol spans include transport and are not pure CPU measurements.
Worker clocks do not advance during synchronous CPU work. Zero spans do not imply zero work.
Bound-root D1 counters cover admission and execution, not all D1 work in the full flow.
Requested APAC placement does not prove physical colocation.
nextWork: The remaining delays are role preparation and execution boundaries. A future candidate needs a demonstrated removable dependency, with admission, fresh cancellation checks, and durable replay preserved. The separate B preparation already overlaps A preparation; moving it behind A without a new dependency design would serialize work.
